items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: Charles Greenlee was married to Coltrane’s cousin Mary.

ctx.x: Well it’s partly a spiritual thing, don’t you think?

Coltrane. John Coltrane was one of the most humble people that you ever wanted to — and one of the most focused people. Eric Dolphy. Eric Dolphy, we lived, a bunch of us lived in the same house. See how I got to know Coltrane personally, I had met him in the fifties but I had really got to know him because I lived at this house. When you see on Eric Dolphy’s record “245” — 245 was the address of a brownstone that Slide Hampton owned in Brooklyn. 245 Carleton Avenue. And Charles Greenlee was married to Coltrane’s…
